hero.title: One meadow,
hero.lede: A sailcloth tent on the lawn above the river, for vows, dinner and dancing until eleven. Scroll through a day here, from the empty tent to the last dance.

stages.c: Sailcloth, cedar poles and a coir floor on the lawn. The morning is yours to set up.
White chairs in rows, an aisle of petals and an arch of hydrangeas at the river end.
A hundred and forty people find their seats as the band plays you in.
Cocktails on the terrace while our crew turns the tent around, every chair to a table.
Eighteen tables of eight, linen, candles and flowers cut from the estate garden.
String lights on, tables to the side and a dance floor in the middle until a quarter to eleven.

spaces.title: Three spaces,
spaces.sub: Marry in the tent or by the river, eat under sailcloth, dance until eleven. Here is how many each one holds.

list.d: Dinner and dancing for up to 160, May through October.
